viewer.preparing: The download link is being prepared.

held.title: This file is held
held.scanPending: Held for the virus scan: it opens once the scan says it is clean.
held.infected: The virus scan found something in this file: it cannot be opened or downloaded.
held.scanFailed: The virus scan could not check this file: it stays closed until it is checked again.
held.checks: The store's checks refused this file (its size, type or contents did not match): it cannot be opened.

card.heic: HEIC photo: this browser cannot show it here. Download it to open it.
card.audio: Voice note: download it to listen to it.
card.office: Office file: download it to open it in its program.
card.other: This file cannot be shown here. Download it to open it.

original.title: Original e-mail
original.failedTitle: A sender check failed: the mail may not come from who it says.

spf.pass: SPF: the sending server may send for this domain.
spf.fail: SPF failed: the sending server may not send for this domain.

dkim.pass: DKIM: the signature matches, the mail was not changed on the way.
dkim.fail: DKIM failed: the signature does not match.

dmarc.pass: DMARC: the sender's domain vouches for this mail.
dmarc.fail: DMARC failed: the sender's domain does not vouch for this mail.

original.picturesBlocked_one: One picture from the internet is not shown, so the sender cannot see that the mail was opened.
original.picturesBlocked_other: {count} pictures from the internet are not shown, so the sender cannot see that the mail was opened.
original.frame: The e-mail as it arrived (links shown as text, nothing runs)

leave.title: Leave with unsent text?
leave.lost: What you wrote in the box is lost.
leave.files_one: The file waiting in the box is not sent.
leave.files_other: The {count} files waiting in the box are not sent.

close.title: Close the thread of {record}?
close.noParty: Nobody can write here until the thread is reopened.
close.mail: Their e-mails will wait in Mail to sort.
close.office: Everyone who could read it still can.
close.conflict: Someone changed the thread meanwhile. Reload it and try again.

send.title: Check before sending
send.allClear: Nothing to check: every address belongs to this customer.
send.heldDanger: Fix what the check found first.
send.heldOutside: Tick “Send outside this customer”, or take the address off.
send.outsideTitle: An address does not belong to this customer.
send.outsideRecorded: The tick is recorded with your name and the addresses.

none.approvals: No request waits for an answer.
